meta.title: cloud3 — Watch. Read. Listen.
meta.desc: cloud3 is an open-source Android player for movies, series and manga. Download the latest build, see the app, and play the record.
meta.ogAlt: cloud3 — the Android app for movies, series and manga

hero.title: Watch. Read.
hero.lead: One player for your films, your series and your manga. You pick the sources; the app stays out of your way.
hero.alt: Makima from Chainsaw Man, illustrated from behind with a red braid

features.title: Your library, not a content store
features.lead: cloud3 ships empty. You choose the sources, and the app stays out of your way.

items.title: Films and series
items.line: Add any CloudStream-compatible extension and its sources appear in search and browse at once.

items.title: Manga, kept separate

download.warn: Play Protect may warn about an app installed outside Play. That is normal for a build published by its author. The source is public, so you can check what the file does.

items.a: Yes. Free, no ads, no account required. You can support it with a donation, but nothing is locked behind one.

items.q: Does it include films, series or manga?
items.a: No. cloud3 ships with no content and no sources. Everything you watch or read comes from extensions you install yourself.
Open the extensions screen, add the repository URL, then install the sources you want. They appear in search and browse immediately.
Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer. It is built for phones and adapts to tablets.
Yes, under GPL v3. The code is on GitHub, and every official build is produced by GitHub Actions from that code.
Install the new APK over the old one and your library, history and settings stay.

sections.p: cloud3 is a player and a library. The app contains no films, series, manga, channels or providers, and this site hosts none of them. Everything you watch or read comes from external extensions you choose and install yourself.

The extensions and sources they point at are written and maintained by other people. cloud3 does not control them, does not review what they show, and cannot vouch for their legality where you live. You are responsible for what you add and for following the laws that apply to you.

The project is not affiliated with CloudStream, Mihon, Keiyoushi, Nuvio, Google, or any content provider, studio or streaming service. Names are mentioned only to identify the origin of code or the extension format.
cloud3 is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. You may use, study, modify and share it under the same license. The full text is in the LICENSE file in the repository.
Keep the project open source. Keep the attribution. State your changes clearly. And please do not sell the app or a build of it.

cloud3 builds on open-source work: CloudStream for the extension system, Nuvio for the cinematic interface (GPL-3.0), and Mihon for the manga compatibility layer (Apache-2.0). The NOTICE file lists every ported file.
Questions about any of this belong in the Telegram channel.

The Makima image at the top of the page is fan art of a Chainsaw Man character, and its rights belong to their owners. It is not part of cloud3 and implies no affiliation. The record artwork and audio files come from the bundled Vinyl project.
